audience: property managers using Arthur to track lettings, maintenance and compliance

useCases.title: Review vacant units and upcoming availability
useCases.text: List units with vacancy or availability filters, then inspect a selected unit and its linked property. Follow the returned pagination to review the portfolio.

useCases.title: Review overdue rent transactions
useCases.text: List overdue transactions for the period you choose and inspect selected records to review amounts, dates and payment status.

useCases.title: Check property certificate expiry dates
useCases.text: List certificates and inspect their expiry dates, types and linked properties to identify records that need attention.

useCases.title: Create a maintenance task for a selected unit
useCases.text: Inspect the unit and its existing tasks, then confirm the unit, description and due date before creating a maintenance task.
